meta.titleFlightSimulator: Flight simulator online — fly a plane in 3D for free — cv.cm
meta.descFlightSimulator: Free online flight simulator in 3D: take off from the runway, fly over a low-poly island and land again, or race through 12 rings against the clock. No download; works with a keyboard or on a phone.

flight-simulator.name: Flight simulator
flight-simulator.blurb: Take off, fly over an island and land, or race through rings.

flight-simulator.q1: How do I fly the plane?
flight-simulator.a1: W and S set the throttle. The arrow keys steer: Left and Right roll the wings, Up pushes the nose down and Down pulls it up, as on a real stick (tick Invert pitch to swap them). A and D turn the rudder. R starts over.
flight-simulator.q2: How do I take off and land?
flight-simulator.a2: In Free flight you start on the runway. Hold W for full throttle, and once you pass about 145 km/h pull the nose up gently. To land, line up with the runway, slow to about 150 km/h, keep the wings level and let the plane sink slowly onto it. Touch down too fast, in a bank or off the runway and you crash.
flight-simulator.a3: You start in the air and fly through 12 rings in order: the bright pink one is next. The clock runs from the start, and your best time is kept in this browser.
flight-simulator.q4: Can I play on a phone?
flight-simulator.a4: Yes. On a touch screen buttons appear on the view: ▲ and ▼ for the nose, + and − for the throttle, ◀ and ▶ to roll. Full screen gives you the most room.
flight-simulator.q5: Is it a realistic flight simulator?
flight-simulator.a5: No, it is an arcade flight game with simplified physics: lift, drag, stalling below about 110 km/h and coordinated turns are modelled, but the plane is forgiving so anyone can fly it in a minute.

flight-simulator.lead: Fly the plane in three steps.
flight-simulator.s1b: Press Play, hold W for full throttle and pull the nose up once the speed passes about 145 km/h.
flight-simulator.s2b: Roll with the left and right arrows to turn, keep the speed up and watch for the STALL warning.
flight-simulator.s3b: Line up with the runway and sink gently onto it, or switch to Rings and fly through all 12 for a best time.

flightSim.title: Flight simulator
flightSim.privacyNote: Take off from the runway, fly over the island and land again, or race through the rings. Nothing is uploaded.
flightSim.intro: Fly a small plane over a low-poly island. Press Play to load the 3D view.
flightSim.hint: W / S throttle · ← → roll · ↑ nose down, ↓ nose up (like a stick) · A / D rudder · R restart. On a phone use the buttons on the view.
flightSim.freeGo: On the runway: hold W for full throttle, then pull up past about 145 km/h.
flightSim.ringsGo: Fly through the pink ring. The clock is running.
flightSim.crashWater: Splash! You went into the sea.
flightSim.crashHard: Crash! You hit the ground too hard.
flightSim.landed: Landed. Nicely done! Throttle up to take off again.
